---
title: "07 — Climatologies and anomalies"
format: html
---

## Goal

Construct reusable climatologies/anomalies only after the underlying absolute variables and temporal coverage are validated.

## Requirements

- frozen baseline period;
- explicit calendar/month/day treatment;
- minimum temporal coverage rules;
- source/product/version homogeneity assessment;
- baseline sample-size diagnostics;
- edge and missingness handling;
- separate provenance for climatology and anomaly products.

## Rule

Absolute environmental products remain the canonical reusable layer. Climatologies and anomalies are derived products and must not overwrite them.
